senses.gloss:
1. अह् अह् (ह् for घ्; cf. Lat. adag + ium, ajo for agjo, nego; Goth. aikan), forms only 2. sing. and du., and 3. sing. du., and plur. of the redupl. pf.
 1. To say, speak, Man. 9, 47.
 2. To specify, Man. 8, 122.
 3. To call, MBh. 3, 16065.
 4. To pronounce, Man. 9, 44.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र,
 1. To pronounce, Man. 9, 45.
 2. To say, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 8.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To answer. Hit. 10, 2.
 --Cf. ἦ = आह.
† 2. अह् अह्, ii. 5, अह्नु, Par. To pervade, or occupy (v. r. अड्).
